field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the items of the feed

field.name: url
field.comment: The address of the RSS or Atom feed the items are read from

field.name: dateFormat
field.comment: A format accepted by the date() PHP function, used for the date of the items

field.name: itemsToDisplay
field.comment: How many items of the feed are displayed

field.name: showSummary
field.comment: true: the summary of every item is displayed below its title; false: only the titles are displayed

field.name: launchInNewWindow
field.comment: true: the items open in another window; false: they open in the same one

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the items: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
